name: pancreatic lipase related protein 3

function.text: PNLIPRP3 is the approved symbol for pancreatic lipase related protein 3. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in glycerophospholipid phospholipase A1 activity; lipoprotein lipase activity; cholesterol homeostasis.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Esophageal carcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.
